risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well-quantified, with clear year-over-year operating and liquidity metrics. Risk factors include a $20.9 million cash decline, increased borrowings and inventory, reduced credit availability, and uncertain future investment and payment timing. Management maintains a positive outlook based on backlog and order trends, but this optimism is partly forward-looking and dependent on demand and execution.
